text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are!
The first battle for the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Which Umamusume will claim the cherry blossom crown
and sprint up the stairs to the queen's throne?!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
“—Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet, who sparked fireworks at the Tulip Sho,
are also running today.”

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
A showdown between the leading stars gracing the Tiara route.
Oh man, this race is going to be a sight to behold!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, as if I would.
If anything, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Once this race is over, I'll definitely be one step closer to the top.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, as expected, it looks like
that girl is entering this race too, but—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But you know, let me tell you!
I'm not bothered by her presence in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The first tiara is gonna be mine, too!
I'll be number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on. Let's go seize the crown of the Queen of Cherries!
